fixes.explanation: That's it, baker. Paul says God, intending to show His wrath and make His power known, “…bore with great patience the vessels of His wrath, prepared for destruction?” Notice the word "bore." God doesn't just put up with them, He bears with them patiently. Even with wrath in view, patience is the word Paul picks (Romans 9:22).
Yes, baker. God says in Hosea, “I will call them ‘My People’ who are not My people…” Hosea was a prophet (Hosea 1:1-2). People once called not His own get a new name from Him.
